name: cavemio-prompt-composer
title: Prompt composer
description: The input that starts it all: grows as you type, takes files, and turns Send into Stop while answering.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Enter sends only when not composing with an IME, so Chinese, Japanese and Korean input works.
- The send button’s label changes with its job: Send, Sending or Stop.
- The text grows to 200px, then scrolls.
- Paste with files attaches them; paste with text still pastes the text.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion, icons, folds and the counter change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onSubmit / onStop
props.description: – · Send the prompt; stop the answer while streaming.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: – · Controlled or uncontrolled text. Uncontrolled clears itself after sending.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "Ask anything" · Also used as the input’s accessible label.

props.name: disabled / disabledReason
props.description: – · Lock the input and say why.

props.name: onFilesSelected / accept
props.description: – · Enables the paperclip, paste and drag and drop.

props.name: attachments / toolbar
props.description: – · Chips above the text; controls at the bottom left.

props.name: maxLength / allowEmpty
props.description: – · A counter appears near the limit; allow sending files without text.

useCases.title: AI chat apps
useCases.description: The main input of a chat built on the AI SDK.

useCases.title: In-product assistants
useCases.description: A help or copilot box inside a SaaS app.

useCases.title: AI tools that take files
useCases.description: Let people attach documents or images to a prompt.

useCases.title: Free tiers and limits
useCases.description: Lock the input and say why when a limit has been reached.

features.title: It grows as you type
features.description: The field grows up to 200px and then scrolls.

features.title: Enter sends
features.description: Shift+Enter adds a line, and IME input in Chinese, Japanese and Korean never sends early.

features.title: Send, waiting, Stop
features.description: Send blurs into a spinner while waiting for the first token, then into Stop while the answer streams.

features.title: Files three ways
features.description: The paperclip, paste and drag and drop all attach files. Chips fold open above the field.

features.title: A counter near the limit
features.description: Past 80% of maxLength a counter opens in and rolls as you type. It turns red over the limit.

features.title: Disabled with a reason
features.description: Lock the input and the reason folds open above it.

states.title: ready
states.description: Type; Send is enabled once there’s text (or files, with allowEmpty).

states.title: submitted
states.description: Sent and waiting for the first token: the arrow shrinks away through a 3px blur as a spinner grows in.

states.title: streaming
states.description: The spinner blurs into Stop, which calls onStop.

states.title: error
states.description: Back to ready so the user can resend.

states.title: disabled
states.description: Input locked, with your reason folding open above it (380ms).

states.title: dragging
states.description: A dashed border and "Drop files to attach" fading in while files are dragged over.

states.title: near the limit
states.description: Past 80% of maxLength the counter opens in and rolls with each keystroke; it turns red once you’re over.
